items.title: News from mwcode, without updating
items.summary: Announcements and release notes now reach you here, even between versions.
points: The list is a signed file from GitHub. mwcode only shows it if the signature checks out.
Nothing about you is sent when it checks.
You can switch it off at the bottom of this page.

list: The feed carries a signature made with a key only the mwcode team holds. The app has the matching public key and refuses anything else.
An older copy of the feed cannot replace a newer one.
Text only: no scripts, no markup. Links open in your browser and only to github.com or the mwcode site.
Pictures are used only when their contents match a fingerprint inside the signed feed.

sections.text: At startup and about every six hours while the app is open. If you are offline, the last good copy stays.
